answer: Rule: one new identity needs one established guarantor locking 50 units, twice the newcomer's 25-unit stake, chains capped at depth 3. A proven fake burns both stakes, 75 units, and the guarantor loses guarantee rights for 10 epochs. One fake risks 75 units; ten need 750 units plus ten guarantor slots, capped at two per guarantor per epoch. Crossing this tundra, only backed identities reach the summit, and an ivory-tower fake never activates.
